data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'saudan', meaning 'to sing a victory song'. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes the victory of faith over adversity. The name Saudra carries the meaning “Victory song” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Saudra usually hope their child will grow to embody victory song and live with faith, good character and purpose.
